scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A gray-bearded king in a gold circlet, cream tunic and rust-red mantle sits at a wooden table, touching a pebble beside grouped counting stones. His other hand rests against his forehead. A dark shadow looms behind him; a sunlit hill town and olive trees appear through a stone arch.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: David's counting stones imagine his decision to number Israel; the distant town evokes the people. The looming shadow symbolizes Satan's opposition and incitement, not a visible encounter described by the verse. The room, garments and counting method are illustrative choices.
